content:
Alex: opened PR to add a compact migration snippet for customers moving from VPC peering to Transit Gateway, plus a tiny nftables + systemd hint. PR: https://github.com/redwood/docs/pull/2551
Maria: This is great. We should make the migration steps minimal: route table diff, BGP stub note, and an optional egress NAT example for TGW.
Alex: Drafting a route diff block and an ascii flowchart. Keeping all examples generic (no real ARNs/IPs).
Jia: nftables snippet (buster test):
```
# accept new + established from on-prem HSM range
table inet rw_kms {
  chain input { type filter hook input priority 0; policy drop; }
}
add rule inet rw_kms input ct state established,related accept
add rule inet rw_kms input ip saddr 10.10.0.0/24 tcp dport 23456 accept
```
Sam: systemd override for flaky links:
```
[Service]
Restart=on-failure
RestartSec=8
LimitNOFILE=32768
```
Sam: Offline verify commands: `gpg --verify bundle.tar.gz.sig bundle.tar.gz` and `sha256sum -c bundle.sha256` + note to import the offline verification key.
Tess: editorial: standardize to uppercase HSM and use "Transit Gateway" phrasing. Also please avoid publishing PKCS11 slot IDs.
DocsBot: CI: linkcheck -> docs/private/migration.md '#tgw-egress' missing (job #719)
Alex: Pushed a commit to add the missing anchor and a brief backport patch for the 1.0 installer docs.
Maria: Happy to review the wording after your push. I'll focus on the peering vs TGW tradeoffs.
Alex: Pushed fixes; CI green. Ready to merge if no objections.
Sam: Can we add a single-line changelog entry so support can triage customer questions?
Alex: Added changelog line: "docs: add peering->Transit Gateway migration snippet, nftables and systemd hints, offline verification notes (backported to 1.0)"
Maria: LGTM.
DocsBot: PR merged and backported to release/1.0.x. Thread closed.
